seed_memories.content: eval/mcnemar.rs implements paired McNemar non-inferiority testing for the eval harness: it counts discordant pairs, computes the Wilson score confidence interval for the proportion of B-wins, and exposes a single mcnemar(slices) entrypoint used by both rein-eval and the trust measurement op.
